title: Stupid DBC
description: A stupidly made mod to be a Dragon Ball Character!
body:
Do you wanna do some stupid sh** like killing every mob in one punch while working on a Steam Engine?
Or do you wanna host tournaments with your friends while working on a Electricity Setup?
That's what this mod aims to do!

You can become a Saiyan or Human, with more races to come in the future!

No Forms or Techniques yet, but there will be some soon!

Mod is based on Dragon Block C by Jinryuu

Gallery to be filled later when there's actual visual stuff to show off.

-------------------------

You have 6 Stats, while only four are used (until 0.2a that is >:) )


Strength: This is your Attack Damage. Pretty Simple.

Dexterity: This is your Speed and Defense. Increasing it makes you faster and take less damage

Constitution: Your Health and Stamina. Stamina controls how often you can punch!

Willpower: Increases Ki Potency (currently unused)

Mind: Increases TP Gain

Spirit: Increases Ki Pool (currently unused)


In this mod, you get to be a Saiyan or another race from Dragon Ball and fight stuff!
No Mobs added yet, will be added in the future

I js wanted to be a Saiyan and do Aeronautics :3

-------------------------



This mod is made in MCreator
